newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson starts Great Western proxy.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson starts Great Western proxy.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co said it has begun a proxy solicitation of Great Western Financial Corp stockholders to elect three directors to the Great Western board.

The election of the directors is one of three key steps that would enable Great Western stockholders to choose between Ahmanson's hostile proposal and Washington Mutual Inc's friendly merger proposal on their respective merits, the holding company said.
Washington Mutual and Great Western have set June 13 for special shareholder votes on their proposed merger.
Ahmanson said the other key steps would involve voting against the Great Western-Washington Mutual merger and tendering shares of Great Western into Ahmanson's exchange offer in the coming weeks.
Ahmanson must first get clearance from the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) for the exchange offer.
Ahmanson also said a May 30 hearing date has been set for its motion for an injunction that would postpone the June 13 Great Western shareholder vote on the Great Western/Washington Mutual deal.
